utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. Just send me the updated list and timing, and I’ll help out.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great—thanks, Oren. I’ll send the updated list and timing, and meet me at the community shed for the first repairs.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and what repairs are needed for the drive? I want to make sure I’ve got the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure — once Eli confirms it, I’ll send you the date, time, and repair list so you can plan around it.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Yep, send me the details and I’ll spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Good — you’ll actually spread the word once I send them, right?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I’m waiting on Eli to finalize the date, time, and repair list, and I’ll send it over as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, thanks, Faye — once Eli finalizes it, I’ll pass the date, time, and repair list along to everyone.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds like Mara’s keeping the repair drive moving nicely. If there’s anything to pick up or drop off while I’m out, just let me know.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word about the repair drive right away so more folks can pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — just keep me posted if anything shifts with the repair drive, and I’ll bring the tools we need.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh right, thanks — I’ll let you know if anything changes, and if you still need supplies I can help track those down.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help with the repair drive and keep it low-key. Just let me know the practical bits when you have them.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — I’ll send you the practical details and keep it simple.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Absolutely — I’m still in for the repair drive, just keeping it low-key for now. I’ll pass along the final date, time, and repair list as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Dane — that helps a lot. I’ve got it down as Sunday at the community center, and I’ll keep everyone posted on the final list and timing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll keep spreading the word about the repair drive and let everyone know if anything changes.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, Vik — I’m still waiting on the final date, time, and repair list, and I’ll pass them along as soon as I get them.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m still tracking the repair drive location, Jules, and I’ll pass along any updates right away if anything shifts.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Opal — I really appreciate it. I’ll keep coordinating the setup and let you know if I need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, I’m still in for the repair drive—send me the updated list and timing, and I’ll bring tools if needed.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works, Leo — I’ll keep the word moving and send the updated list and timing when I have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Still on it — I’m swamped, but I’ll get you the date, time, and repair list soon.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Bo — just send me the date, time, and repair list when you have them, and I’ll help spread the word.
